extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings in a divorce; applicant represented
extracted.summary: A senior associate at Ashcroft & Beckford Law enquires about a £35,000 litigation loan to fund counsel, a forensic accountant and solicitor costs for the applicant in financial remedy proceedings where around £348,500 of property and pension assets are in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £35,000 sought and the approximately £348,500 in assets in dispute, and we will send our criteria and application form. To progress matters, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the case, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the assets in dispute including any existing charges. Client identification and conflict-check details would also be helpful. Nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or an indication of terms.
